title: Collateral Detail
description: Detailed collateral information with coverage type and financial values

collateralCoverageType.$comment: Consult External Code List table ExternalCollateralCoverageTypeCode

totalValueOfCollateral.description: Total value of the collateral (post-haircut) held by the exposed party. This field has 2 decimal places

riskWithoutCollateral.description: Risk Exposure without collaterals at EoD. This field has 2 decimal places

additionalMargin.description: Additional Margin based on positions limit. This field has 2 decimal places

collateralBalance.description: Remaining value (positive value) or debit (negative value) of collateral. This field has 2 decimal places

informationType.description: Information regarding the party collateral position
informationType.$comment: Consult External Code List table ExternalInformationTypeCode

additionalInformationOfficialCollCall.description: Additional information regarding the collateral call

intradayRiskLimitAssigned.description: This block contains the value of the intraday risk limit determined by the responsible in the chain of responsibility

riskWithoutCollateralIntraday.description: Risk Exposure without collaterals at EoD

collateralBalanceIntraday.description: Intraday remaining value (positive value) or debit (negative value) of collateral. This field has 2 decimal places

projectedBalance.description: Remaining value (positive value) or debit (negative value) of collateral considering intraday and official margin run. This field has 2 decimal places

additionalInformationIntradayCollCall.description: Additional information regarding the intraday collateral call
